cardOverview.overviewText: A Spark 5 card crafted for everyday users, offering steady rewards on shopping and dining spends with easy redemption.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: On purchase of one movie ticket on BookMyShow app or website, get a discount of up to ₹200 on the second ticket.|Benefit can be availed once per month per DBS Spark Credit Card, including add-on cards.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail the DBS Spark Credit Card "Buy-One-Get-One-Free" movie ticket offer on BookMyShow, select your movie, choose at least two seats, and proceed to payment. Under "Unlock Offer or Apply Promocodes," select "DBS Bank Credit Card Offer," enter your card details, and apply the discount (up to ₹200 on the second ticket). Pay with your DBS Spark Credit Card to complete the booking. This offer is valid once per month per card and applies only to movie tickets. For details, visit BookMyShow's offer page.
